comments.text:
Extend the ParamRegistry (from i7-49c.1) with entries for all tone editor parameters.

SCOPE:
- SN-S: Common params (tone level, portamento, mono, octave shift, pitch bend, unison, legato, analog feel, wave shape) + per-partial params (OSC wave/pitch/detune/PW, filter mode/cutoff/reso/env, amp level/vel/pan/env, LFO shape/rate/depth x4, mod LFO x4, aftertouch)
- SN-A: Common params (tone level, portamento, mono, legato, octave shift, cutoff/reso offsets, per-instrument params)
- SN-D: Common params (kit level, EQ switch) + per-note params (inst number, level, pan, tune, chorus/reverb send, output assign)
- PCM-S: Common params + PMT (structure, booster, partial switches) + per-partial (wave/WMT, pitch env, TVF, TVA, LFO1/2, step LFO, output) + Common2 (tone category, phrase number)
- PCM-D: Common params (kit name, kit level) + per-key (WMT x4, pitch env, TVF, TVA, misc, output assign) + Common2 (phrase number, TFX switch)

REFERENCE: See web/src/sn-synth/types.ts, web/src/pcm-synth/types.ts, web/src/pcm-drum/types.ts for the complete field lists with offset addresses and value ranges used in the React UI.

title: Core: add ParamRegistry entries for tone editor parameters
